summary.description: 1-2 sentences: the trust boundaries this change touches and the security verdict.

severity.description: From the demonstrated impact; none for needs_validation.

attack_class.description: e.g. injection, access control, ssrf, ci.

line.description: New-file line number (the R number in the diff). 0 if not tied to a line.

principal.description: The lower-trust actor and what they control.

boundary.description: The control that fails and the boundary crossed.

trace.description: Entry point -> propagation -> sink, as path:line steps.

impact.description: The affected user or resource and the concrete result.

fix.description: The invariant, the smallest source change and a regression test.

unresolved.description: needs_validation: the exact missing fact. Otherwise empty.
